infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: 1099Suite uses location to automatically track your business mileage trips. This helps you accurately log travel for tax deductions and expense reporting.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: 1099Suite uses background location to automatically detect and log your driving trips, even when the app is closed. This ensures you never miss a business mile for tax deductions. Your location data is only used for mileage tracking and is never shared with third parties.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: This app uses your reminders to add and view reminders.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: This app uses contacts to help you manage client relationships and business contacts.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app uses the camera to capture receipts and documents for expense tracking.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This app uses tracking to provide personalized follow-up reminders and improve your business workflow.
